subject: Request: Pricing comparison and vendor swap feasibility (ModelStream replacement)
messages:
From: Kara Simmons <kara.simmons@cloudforge.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor price match request: ModelStream offer attached

Hi Diego,

Quick note from procurement — we received a competing offer from ModelStream for our inference footprint. They quoted $0.004/token with a 12-month committed term and are offering migration support (engineer hours + delta testing) if we sign by Aug 10.

We like Redwood’s performance profile, but the price delta is material. Can Redwood provide a competitive price match (or equivalent economic incentive) and an outline of the vendor-replacement steps (timeline, risk mitigation, who owns what)? Procurement wants a response by EOD Aug 6 to include in our vendor evaluation packet.

Attached: modelstream_offer.pdf (commercial summary)

Thanks,
Kara Simmons
Senior Procurement Manager
CloudForge

--
CloudForge Procurement
procurement@cloudforge.com

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Kara Simmons <kara.simmons@cloudforge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor price match request: ModelStream offer attached

Kara — thanks for the heads up and for sharing the offer. Appreciate the timeline.

Short answer: yes, we can build a competitive package, but final pricing depends on committed volumes and a short technical validation (sequence length mix, avg tokens per request, and peak qps). To move quickly I put together a preliminary price comparison and a migration outline. See attachments: redwood_initial_price_match.xlsx and migration_timeline_v1.pdf.

High level options we can offer now (prelim):
- 15% per-token price match for the first 6 months assuming 12-month commitment at your published monthly volume (requires contract addendum).
- Dedicated onboarding credit (engineering hours) to cover data migration and test harnesses (scoped in playbook).
- Option to move to a Dedicated/Reserved pool for predictable throughput — further discount available if you commit to reserved capacity.

Next steps I propose:
1) You share a quick usage snapshot (avg tokens/day, p95 latency targets, expected growth).
2) We schedule a 30-45m migration scoping call early next week to confirm requirements.
3) We finalize commercial terms and provide a DocuSign-ready addendum.

If it helps, Marissa (cc’d) can surface an accelerated commercial approval path.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0104

--
Attachments: redwood_initial_price_match.xlsx (pricing comparison stub), migration_timeline_v1.pdf (2-page timeline)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Kara Simmons <kara.simmons@cloudforge.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor price match request: ModelStream offer attached

Looping in possible promo levers and finance.

Diego — nice summary. For CloudForge I suggest we present a clean, single-sheet commercial that includes two paths:
1) Consumption match: 15% first-6-months per-token credit + $50k onboarding credit applied to month 1 invoice.
2) Reserved path: 10% lower list price off our hosted per-token for a 12-month reserved commitment plus migration assistance (onboarding credit + 2 dedicated SRE days).

Also flag for legal/finance: if CloudForge requires SLA escalations above our standard enterprise SLA we will need a short approval. I have availability to fast-track with Finance for a one-off promo if Diego confirms expected ARR bucket (approx $/mo).

Diego — when you send the commercial, include a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with milestones (PO signed, migration PoC, parallel testing window, cutover) and the owner for each step. Kara, if you can confirm target monthly spend range, we’ll pull the final commercial and DocuSign later today.

-Marissa
VP Sales | Redwood Inference

--
Internal note: Finance pre-approved up to $75k in onboarding credits for strategic migrations in Q3.

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Kara Simmons <kara.simmons@cloudforge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T12:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor price match request: ModelStream offer attached

Kara — thanks again. Based on the usage buckets you mentioned on the call, here’s the commercial we can put forward today: 

Offer (summary):
- Per-token pricing: Redwood will match ModelStream economics net of a 15% introductory credit applied to the per-token rate for months 1–6, conditional on a 12-month commitment (Deal ID CF-2026-0912).
- Onboarding credit: $50,000 credit to cover migration engineering and validation (applied as invoice credit).
- Migration scope: 4-week technical PoC (parallel run) followed by a 2-week production cutover window. We’ll provide a playbook and a 1-week smoke test plan.
- SLA: Standard enterprise SLA applies; any SLA uptick requests will need legal sign-off (Marissa is looped).

Attachments: cloudforge_swap_playbook.pdf (detailed step-by-step), redwood_initial_price_match.xlsx (commercial worksheet)

Next steps (clear asks):
1) Kara — confirm expected monthly spend band (e.g., $100k–$200k/mo) so I can lock the final numbers.
2) If you accept the offer, I’ll generate a DocuSign addendum and schedule the PoC kickoff for week of Aug 17.
3) Please also share the procurement contact who will execute the addendum.

If you’d like we can provide a 3-day technical window before the PoC to validate tokenization differences and latency baselines.

Looking forward — we want to make this swap low-risk and time-boxed.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: cloudforge_swap_playbook.pdf, redwood_initial_price_match.xlsx

From: CloudForge Procurement <procurement@cloudforge.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Kara Simmons <kara.simmons@cloudforge.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor price match request: ModelStream offer attached

Diego / Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround and the playbook. Procurement is aligned to move this to commercial review. A few notes: 

- We like the 15% introductory credit + $50k onboarding. Please provide the DocuSign-ready addendum and the formal commercial worksheet so our legal and procurement teams can review.
- We plan to start the PoC week of Aug 17 — please confirm availability for the technical kickoff and provide the list of required CloudForge stakeholders and access requirements.
- Our procurement lead who will execute the agreement is Jamie Lee (jamie.lee@cloudforge.com). Please route the addendum to that address.

We’ll aim to provide formal feedback by Aug 10 after internal routing.

Thanks,
CloudForge Procurement
procurement@cloudforge.com
